posts.headline: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump Tariffs, Markets Rally
posts.body: The Supreme Court struck down President Trump's sweeping tariffs, sending stocks rallying. The S&P 500 gained 0.7% and the Nasdaq snapped a 5-week losing streak. Investors celebrated the ruling as a major win for markets.

posts.headline: Nvidia on Track for $3 Trillion Market Cap
posts.body: Nvidia's market cap trajectory shows its extraordinary ascent from $65 billion in 2017 to over $3 trillion today. Wall Street expects 57% YoY growth for fiscal year 2026, fueling the AI rally.

posts.headline: Tech Stocks Surge on Tariff Ruling
posts.body: Tech stocks led the rally after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's tariffs. The sector benefited from reduced trade uncertainty. Investors now eye the Fed's next move.

posts.headline: GDP Misses Expectations Despite Market Rally
posts.body: Economic growth data disappointed despite the market rally. GDP came in below expectations, creating mixed sentiment. Traders weigh continued growth concerns against tariff relief.

posts.headline: February 26 Could Be Huge Day for Markets
posts.body: Market analysts flag February 26 as a potentially significant day for stocks. Multiple catalysts are lining up that could drive substantial movement. Traders positioning accordingly.
